<function name="GetShader" parent="IMaterial" type="classfunc">
	<description>
Returns the name of the materials shader.

<bug issue="3256">This function does not work serverside on Linux SRCDS and always returns `shader_error`.

This bug is fixed on `dev` beta and in the next update.
</bug>
	</description>
	<realm>Shared and Menu</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="string">Name of the currently loaded shader for this material, or `shader_error` if the material has no loaded shader.

It is not guaranteed to be in any specific capitalization, so case insensitive checks are advised.
</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
